differences.aspect: hidden random source and repeated object calls
differences.native: LeetCode constructs Solution(w); each pickIndex() obtains a hidden random() value.
differences.app: solve(w, random_values) defines random() over the authored values and calls the same pickIndex calculation once per value.
differences.rationale: The offline judge must expose randomness and a finite call count. Prefix sums, total weight, scaled target, bisect_right selection, and per-pick logarithmic complexity are identical after the random-source adapter.
